children.text: Eligibility criteria and T&Cs apply. Unfortunately if anyone in your home is reliant on life support equipment, you’re ineligible. Maximum incentive only claimable when joining Origin Loop. Only valid with Tesla, Sungrow, LG Chem and Goodwe battery systems. To be eligible, your battery system must comply with the following: Your battery/s are intended for use in residential or small business premises in South Australia. You have not previously received a rebate for this activity under the SA REPS at the address where the battery is installed in the past three years. Your battery/s are connected to a VPP approved under the REPS in South Australia. Your battery/s were connected to an approved VPP in the current calendar year. Your battery/s were installed by an accredited CEC retailer and installer. The rebate application must be lodged using the date the VPP connection took place. It can be an existing battery installation or new battery installation. VPP connection must be to the battery in use at the address on the application. Claiming more than 1 battery is allowed but maximum rebate is achieved at a total of 28kWh of battery capacity.
